humanRationale: discrediting Pocahontas ≠ humiliating her before the English court ≠ specifically sabotaging her standing with the King.
materialIssues: “plotting to humiliate her before the English court” turns the authorized statement that Ratcliffe will “discredit the young princess” into a specific public-humiliation mechanism and locates that scheme at the English court, neither of which the source establishes.

“plot to sabotage her standing with the King” further specifies the King as the target/audience of Ratcliffe’s discrediting effort, connecting his scheme to Pocahontas’s royal diplomatic meeting in a way the authorized overview does not establish.
